content: For a web-only PWA with no native mobile app, the standards-based Web Push API (VAPID keys + service worker + the 'web-push' npm library) is recommended over Firebase Cloud Messaging: no vendor lock-in, no Google infra dependency, works on Chrome/Edge/Firefox and Safari 16.4+ (installed PWAs only on iOS). FCM is only worth it if a native Android/iOS app is added later needing one unified push pipeline.
